description: Cancelable promise ecosystem based on native Promise: coroutines, async iterators, decorators, utilities, third-party library helpers.
rules: CancelablePromise extends native Promise. Cancellation is represented as a rejection with a CancelError.
Cancellation propagates DOWN promise chains (rejection) and bubbles UP when all child promises are canceled and the value is unconsumed.
CancelablePromise.race and .any cancel losing promises; CancelablePromise.all cancels remaining promises on first rejection or when all itself is canceled.
Never check error identity with instanceof across package boundaries; use isCancelError() guards or catchCancel/suppressCancel/catchAbort/suppressAbort/catchTimeout/suppressTimeout helpers.

No cancel errors should remain unhandled; use isCancelError, catchCancel(), suppressCancel(), catchAbort(), or suppressAbort() to handle them locally; use @cancjs/unhandled-rejection to handle them globally.
Prefer CancelablePromise chains and canc-coroutine over manually threading AbortController signals through function boundaries.
Avoid using CancelablePromise and AbortController constructors directly; prefer higher-level promisify() and cancelify() helpers to create cancelable promises from external APIs.
